const d=$input.first().json; const norm=v=>String(v??'').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g,' '); const sim=(a,b)=>{const x=new Set(norm(a).split(' ').filter(Boolean)),y=new Set(norm(b).split(' ').filter(Boolean)); if(!x.size||!y.size)return 0; const i=[...x].filter(t=>y.has(t)).length; return i/new Set([...x,...y]).size}; const exact=new Map(d.catalogue.map(p=>[norm(p.code).replace(/ /g,'-'),p])); const seen=new Map(),quoteRows=[],reviewRows=[]; for(const r of d.rfqRows){const code=norm(r.code).replace(/ /g,'-'),unit=norm(r.unit).replace(/ /g,''),qty=Number(r.quantity),fp=`${code}|${norm(r.description)}|${unit}`; if(!Number.isFinite(qty)||qty<=0){reviewRows.push({...r,status:'REVIEW',reason:'INVALID_QUANTITY'});continue} if(!unit){reviewRows.push({...r,status:'REVIEW',reason:'MISSING_UNIT'});continue} if(seen.has(fp)){reviewRows.push({...r,status:'REVIEW',reason:seen.get(fp)===qty?'EXACT_DUPLICATE':'CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE'});continue} seen.set(fp,qty); const p=exact.get(code); if(p){if(norm(p.unit).replace(/ /g,'')!==unit){reviewRows.push({...r,status:'REVIEW',reason:'UNIT_MISMATCH',candidateCode:p.code});continue} quoteRows.push({line:r.line,requestedCode:r.code,matchedCode:p.code,description:p.description,quantity:qty,unit:p.unit,unitPrice:p.price,lineTotal:Number((qty*p.price).toFixed(2)),matchMethod:'EXACT_CODE',priceListVersion:d.priceListVersion,status:'READY'});continue} const best=d.catalogue.map(p=>({p,score:sim(r.description,p.description)})).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score)[0]; if(best&&best.score>=.5)reviewRows.push({...r,status:'REVIEW',reason:'DESCRIPTION_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_APPROVAL',candidateCode:best.p.code,confidence:Number(best.score.toFixed(2))}); else reviewRows.push({...r,status:'REVIEW',reason:'NO_APPROVED_MATCH'}); } return [{json:{metadata:{demonstration:d.demonstration,customerData:d.customerData,priceListVersion:d.priceListVersion},quoteRows,reviewRows}}];

const d=$input.first().json; const checks=[['accounted',d.summary.readyRows+d.summary.reviewRows===8],['ready rows',d.summary.readyRows===2],['quote total',d.summary.quoteTotal===378.75],['human review present',d.reviewRows.length===6],['versioned prices',d.quoteRows.every(r=>r.priceListVersion==='synthetic-v1-2026-09-17')],['demo labeled',d.metadata.demonstration===true]]; return [{json:{...d,acceptanceChecks:checks.map(([name,passed])=>({name,passed})),allChecksPassed:checks.every(([,passed])=>passed)}}];
